about.title: About Me
about.story1: Starting from a deep curiosity for coding, I am accustomed to building and restructuring applications from the ground up. My experience is heavily centered around backend development and database logic.
about.story2: Currently, I am pushing my boundaries by diving into the world of Game Development. For me, solving technical problems is not just a job, but a dedication to continuous growth and making a positive impact.

list.title: Kosakataku - AI Language Learning
list.desc: An interactive foreign language vocabulary learning application for elementary students. Integrates OpenAI API along with Google Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech APIs for pronunciation evaluation.

list.title: Enterprise Notification System
list.desc: Migrated a client notification system to an independent internal infrastructure based on Docker and WAHA API, saving operational costs and improving reliability.

list.title: Automated Document Validation
list.desc: Engineered a backend script to programmatically overlay validation stamps and QR codes onto client PDF documents for regional administrative purposes.

list.title: Workshop Monitoring Dashboard
list.desc: Developed a monitoring report page to track and compile monthly diagnostic data entries from various regional service centers utilizing a legacy template system.

Mengembangkan aplikasi web sesuai kebutuhan klien berdasarkan tiket pengembangan. Bekerja dalam lingkungan yang berorientasi pada target dan tenggat waktu, sehingga terbiasa menyelesaikan tugas secara tepat waktu dengan tetap menjaga kualitas hasil.

list.role: IT Staff (Full Stack Developer & IT Support)
list.desc: Responsible for maintaining IT infrastructure, optimizing database queries, and developing internal applications such as workshop monitoring systems and PDF document automation.

Handling various custom web development projects, ranging from Docker-based notification system integrations to AI learning applications. Experienced in time management between primary job and side projects.
